lead_profile_text: Family-owned mews house coming off long-let; run by the lead and her sister for their parents. Mortgage-free.
stl_goal: Run the mews as a holiday rental with her sister as a trial, then possibly convert the parents' other units
property_situation: 1-bed mews house in York owned by her parents, no mortgage, currently unfurnished and being furnished by Rebecca and her sister alongside full-time jobs. Parents also own a 1-bed flat and 2-bed flat (both long-let) and a shop let to a hairdresser, possibly on a single title. Target: live before end of October. Sister missed the call.
primary_blocker: Furnishing and setup still in progress alongside two full-time jobs, sister not on the call, and the parents (legal owners) would need to sign

meeting_flow.opening_phrase: I thought I'd start just by understanding a bit more on sort of your current situation and situation with the property, and then we can go through the income projections in our service if it, you know, lines up with what you're looking to achieve.
rapport_topics: Working from home / someone at the door
Her background and interior design ability
meeting_flow.pivot_to_business: Cool. Quite excited actually, factoring in that, I must say. Um, so for the 1-bed flat, we're looking at sort of gross revenue about £51,000, which is about £4,200 a month.
meeting_flow.income_intro: Now what you can expect as a payout from that each month is going to be about £26,400 per year, about £2,200 per month.
meeting_flow.how_it_works_transition: Yeah, yeah, okay. So it's an end-to-end service. We'll deal with everything to do with managing the guest side of things.
meeting_flow.pre_close_setup: I was going to say, you was talking a little bit on timeframes with this. I mean, I know there's obviously things to do in terms of setup. We can help a bit with that. I can give you a free setup guide or I can give you a price.
meeting_flow.close_phrase: I'll just send a bit of summary of everything we've spoken about and then a bit of an action plan together in a link. I'll put in our agreement as well.
meeting_flow.meeting_2_ask: We'll probably touch base in a couple of weeks, see how the refurb's going. If you need any help in the meantime, just drop me an email or something.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: why is there such a big difference between the 4,000? The £2,000, now you've explained it, I understand all the, like, you've calculated all the fees coming off that, so that makes a lot more sense.
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Three costs: platform commissions, cleaning and laundry (about 18% of gross) and management at 15%; only bills (about £300-£400) to pay out of the net. Range: worst about £1,500 (January), likely £2,200, best about £2,800 (July/August).
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: No, yeah, it's good to just kind of understand things

lead_responses.what_lead_said: how long do you expect, or is it a bit too difficult to say?
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Competitive market (12 comparables within 1km, highly reviewed); expect about 20% below projection until 20-30 reviews, projected average after about year one, peak range in 18 months to 2.5 years. No mortgage makes it a waiting game.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: what's actually involved in that 15%, like what do you do?
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: End-to-end: multi-platform listing (direct site, Airbnb, Booking.com), dynamic pricing, guest screening and deposits, check-in/out, cleaning coordination, maintenance. Owner only handles bills and safety certificates; oversight via calendar, Slack and monthly statement paid 1st-5th.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: we want it to be as nice as possible, but obviously you don't want to go too far with it because ... it's a big chunk of money that you're putting up front ... how luxurious we kind of need to go with it
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Offered case study links for inspiration and the free setup guide with suppliers and furniture packs; York needs a finish that 'looks like effort' but nothing crazy, avoid cheap furniture that is 'knackered after a year'.
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: Okay, yeah, that'd be really helpful. Yeah, thank you.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: You just mentioned snagging. What do you mean?
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Small things a guest might notice such as a wonky or unplugged radiator; Rebecca's bathroom lino and radiator would likely come back in the snagging report anyway, better done beforehand.
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: Okay, no, this has been really helpful.

profile_psychology_intersection.recommended_meeting_adjustment: For family-owned STL-SW leads, confirm who signs and get the co-decision-makers onto the call or into a follow-up; lead with fees (15% + VAT, software, exit fee) and tie the sign-by date to the Christmas market window
